2024-25-worldtour-seoul-4.rule_ref: The first, second and third placed skaters from each race and up to a maximum of two fastest fourth place skaters qualify for Rep. Semifinals.

2024-25-worlds-beijing.rule_ref: The first placed skater from each race and up to a maximum of three fastest second place skaters qualify for Rep Semifinals .
The first placed skater from each race and up to a maximum of four fastest second place skaters qualify for Rep Semifinals.
The first, second and third placed skaters from each race and up to a maximum of two fastest fourth place skaters qualify for Rep. Semifinals.
